identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Swiss Utility' design that blends the precision of recruitment data with the clarity of Swiss design. Avoid generic dashboard templates.
principles: Fusion: Swiss Typography + High-Density Data Utility
Content: Data is the hero. Fit scores and skills must pop.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to separate candidates, not just lines.
Contrast: High contrast for readability. Black text on white, not gray on gray.

theme.name: Swiss Utility
theme.strategy: Light mode base for paper-like readability of resumes. Optional dark mode for power users.
visual_enhancers: Subtle Noise Texture (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to kill digital flatness
No Shadows on cards, only on hover (lift effect)

mono.usage: Tags, Code snippets, IDs, File names

primary.name: Deep Royal Blue
primary.usage: Primary buttons, Active states, Strong Headers

layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Grid for Analytics (12-col). Dense Table for Resume List.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) for containers. Tight gap (gap-2, gap-4) for data points.

UploadZone.interaction: Scale up slightly on drag over. Turns Blue on active.

ResumeCard.style: Flat, 1px border. No shadow default. Hover: Shadow-md + Translate-y-1.
ResumeCard.layout: Flex row. Left: Avatar + Name. Right: Fit Score Badge + Action.

SkillTag.style: Small, rounded-md. bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground. Font-mono text-xs.
SkillTag.state: Green text if matched, Gray if missing.

animations.name: Staggered List
animations.description: Candidates appear one by one with a slide-up fade effect.
animations.props: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, staggerChildren: 0.05 }}

animations.name: Score Countup
animations.description: Fit score number counts up from 0 to actual score.

images.usage: Background for login or processing state

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px (Thin/Elegant). Size 16px-20px for UI, 24px for Nav.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use 'text-slate-900' on white.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-blue-500) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge recharts @radix-ui/react-slot @radix-ui/react-progress`
2. Setup Tailwind colors in `tailwind.config.js` to match the 'Swiss Utility' palette.
3. Create the `UploadZone` component first - it's the entry point.
4. Build the `ResultsTable` using a clean `table` or `grid` layout. Avoid complex DataTables if simple mapping works.
5. Use `recharts` for the Analytics dashboard (Bar chart for scores, Pie for skills).
6. Ensure the 'Processing' state is visually interesting (use the Abstract image + a progress bar).
7. Mock data should be realistic (Python Dev, Data Scientist roles).
8. DO NOT ASK USER FOR CLARIFICATION. JUST BUILD.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill or sharp).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
